name: AIDE ML
description: ML engineering agent that searches a tree of candidate solutions to optimise a metric you describe in plain language.
whatItDoes: Given a data folder, a goal and an evaluation metric, it writes and iteratively improves training scripts and returns the best one. It is used by practitioners and as a research baseline for automated ML.
howItWorks: The agent drafts solutions, runs them, and then debugs or refines the most promising nodes in a solution tree. Results are saved as a best script plus an HTML tree visualisation, and a Streamlit UI is available from a source checkout.

requirements.name: OPENAI_API_KEY
requirements.description: Default model provider; Anthropic, Gemini or an OpenAI-compatible base URL also work

run: aide data_dir="example_tasks/house_prices" goal="Predict the sales price for each house" eval="RMSE between log-prices"
models: OpenAI, Anthropic, Gemini, OpenAI-compatible local models
